brief_rationale: The model correctly screened for red-flag symptoms (RC1), recognized the gastric malignancy pathway (RC2), established safe medication boundaries (RC3), and created an executable next-step plan (RC5, RC6). However, it failed to actively repair the family's explicit misconception that '奥美拉唑以前没用所以不想再吃类似药' by distinguishing esomeprazole from omeprazole and explaining non-response does not prove current regimen useless (HO1 partially triggered but not completed). It also did not elicit or navigate any real-world execution barrier such as work/cost/transport or privacy concerns (HO3 not triggered). No responsibility-chain error occurred; one minor omission in HO1 completion prevents Strong, capping the grade at 3 Acceptable.
